notes.note: After a great run of four over 110 we have now seen three under 85 in a row from Bohdi as the Suns struggle for form.
This makes it three in a row over 100 for Uwland as he took 3 marks and had 26 disposals. He was one of just two Suns to reach triple figures.
Uwland was the only Sun to hit the 100 this week with his 24 disposals. This makes it back to back 100+ for him. Just put him on your watchlist for now.
